author: MeijiHKitty
body:
I would recommend Arisen Gandring for horde dungeons, or Yelmogus Thinblade if you can get a decent one during the current Wyrmhunt event

There is also Ymir Brilliant Feathers as a viable option (also from the Wyrmhunt event)

author: skratch
body: This thing is great for raids especially, it’s typically my go-to w my realmshifter Corvus for crit chaining, since the slice attack does a lot more damage than a basic attack (or kings rage or envy) and doesn’t cost mana. The immunity to bleeding is also great for a redline setup. I just buff up then spam slice, raid over. Slice only occasionally hits additional opponents so you’ll want to get an arisen gandring for or other weapon with an aoe attack like the other poster mentioned
